assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original background painting for a dark fantasy deckbuilding game's main menu, landscape 16:9, high quality. Hand-painted gouache and ink art with strong angular shapes, restrained textured brushwork, dramatic but readable silhouette. A colossal crooked black stone spire with impossible stacked buttresses rises from a windswept jagged gorge on the RIGHT HALF, a narrow winding stair leading toward its amber-lit doorway. Desaturated charcoal, dusty olive, warm stone, muted burnt sienna, pale ochre cloudy sky. A few tiny ember sparks, ancient ruined pillars in foreground. LEFT 48 PERCENT is mostly quiet near-black rock and shadow, low detail negative space reserved for UI text; right side atmospheric and richly illustrated. Bottom strip dark shadow. Strong theatrical composition that feels like a beautiful painted fantasy boardgame, not realistic 3D or glossy concept art. No characters, no lettering, no UI, no logos, no watermark. This will sit behind crisp real UI and must be an actual artwork, not a screenshot or mockup.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six original small fantasy trading-card illustrations in a single 3-column by 2-row CONTACT SHEET. Exact equal rectangular grid, all six cells equal size, each cell is a finished separate illustration, no margins or gutters. Overall canvas landscape 3:2, each cell square. Style throughout: graphic painterly gouache, thick ink outlines, dramatic angular light and rough paper texture, hand-painted boardgame art. Restrained copper, charcoal, bone and muted class colors. TOP LEFT: a silver broadsword slashing diagonally through a copper red field, bold motion strokes. TOP MIDDLE: a battered iron kite shield holding back sparks, charcoal and warm ivory. TOP RIGHT: two curved daggers crossing over deep moss green mist, forest green and pale silver. BOTTOM LEFT: a bright amber fire burning in a clenched armored hand, dark red and gold. BOTTOM MIDDLE: an ancient bronze spherical automaton core crackling with pale turquoise electricity, dark desaturated teal. BOTTOM RIGHT: a purple hooded seer's eye within a radiant circular golden sigil, muted plum and pale gold. Each subject centered with generous surrounding dark negative space so center crops remain readable at small sizes. Six distinct full-bleed square illustrations with clean straight boundaries at exactly one-third and two-thirds width and halfway down. NO typography, card frames, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four original full-body character sprites for a dark fantasy deckbuilding game, arranged in an EXACT 2 by 2 grid contact sheet on a genuinely transparent background. Square canvas, four identical square cells, one centered character per cell with 12 percent transparent margin around all edges, no overlap between cells, whole feet and weapons visible. Consistent hand-painted gouache and ink style, handsome angular silhouettes, rich tactile painterly shading, proportions of a serious fantasy adventure comic rather than tiny cartoon chibi. TOP LEFT: a muscular warrior wearing an aged ivory horned iron face mask, dark bronze armor, torn red cloak and leather wraps, holding a broad weathered sword angled downward. TOP RIGHT: a slender rogue in a tattered deep moss-green hooded cloak, pale long beaked bone mask, two slim curved daggers pointing downward, mysterious poised stance. BOTTOM LEFT: a slightly hunched ancient brass and dark teal clockwork automaton, one glowing amber eye and a round light in its chest, two small pale turquoise lightning orbs floating near its shoulders. Isolated characters ONLY, no scenery, no tile backgrounds, no frames, no text, no labels, no letters, no logo, no ground shadows. All four face slightly toward the right. Transparent background required.
